title: 移動式防洪擋板部署
subcategoryTitle: 輸配水、河川與都市防洪
subcategoryTitleEn: Water conveyance, rivers and urban flood protection
summary: 課程把可拆構件視為包含預警、儲存、運輸、組裝、基礎、密封及抽排的完整系統，逐步估算時程、載重與水量，再以共同原因及演練統計檢查可靠度。比尤德利與科隆提供官方工程背景，全部算例為假設，不作實際啟動水位、錨定配置或產品合格證明。
summaryEn: The course treats removable elements as a system of warning, storage, transport, assembly, foundations, sealing and pumping. It calculates timing, loading and water balance before examining common causes and exercise statistics. Bewdley and Cologne provide official project context. Every example is hypothetical, without prescribing operating triggers, anchorage layouts or product certification.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證」與「平行班組與資源瓶頸機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification" and "Parallel crews and bottlenecks mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「預警提前量與時間餘裕」如何影響移動式防洪擋板部署的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Warning lead time and float” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deployable flood-barrier systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 可拆擋板在洪水前必須完成整條防線的閉合，預警提前量應以安全施工的最晚時間為終點，而不是只看洪峰到達。通知、調度、運輸、組裝與檢查皆消耗時間，且降雨可能同時影響道路和人員；正的平均餘裕只能作規劃起點，仍需處理預報誤差與作業時間分布。本例各階段依序不重疊，提前量與工時均是假設值，不是任何城市的動員觸發門檻；未將人員安全截止時間等同於水到板頂。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「預警提前量與時間餘裕」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A demountable system must close the entire defence before flooding, with lead time ending at the latest safe installation time rather than merely the crest arrival. Alerting, mobilization, transport, assembly and checking all consume time, while weather may affect roads and staff together. Positive average float is a planning starting point that still requires forecast and duration uncertainty. The example has sequential nonoverlapping phases and hypothetical timing, not any city’s mobilization trigger. The safe working deadline is not assumed to occur when water reaches the barrier top. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Warning lead time and float” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設可用提前量TL=8 h，通知0.5 h、動員1 h、運輸1.5 h、組裝3 h、查驗0.5 h，所需6.5 h，餘裕1.5 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume available lead time 8 h: alert 0.5 h, mobilization 1 h, transport 1.5 h, assembly 3 h and inspection 0.5 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要擋板組裝時間短於洪峰到達時間，就一定來得及安全部署。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Assembly shorter than time to the flood crest guarantees timely and safe deployment." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「預警提前量與時間餘裕」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Warning lead time and float”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 可拆擋板在洪水前必須完成整條防線的閉合，預警提前量應以安全施工的最晚時間為終點，而不是只看洪峰到達。通知、調度、運輸、組裝與檢查皆消耗時間，且降雨可能同時影響道路和人員；正的平均餘裕只能作規劃起點，仍需處理預報誤差與作業時間分布。
knowledge.textEn: A demountable system must close the entire defence before flooding, with lead time ending at the latest safe installation time rather than merely the crest arrival. Alerting, mobilization, transport, assembly and checking all consume time, while weather may affect roads and staff together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要擋板組裝時間短於洪峰到達時間，就一定來得及安全部署。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Assembly shorter than time to the flood crest guarantees timely and safe deployment. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「移動式防洪擋板部署」的「預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出流域、入流、儲存、出流與下游的水量邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「洪水量測與河道模型」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與同時間窗的流量、水位、截面與儀器校正紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths” in “Deployable flood-barrier systems”. Draw the catchment, inflow, storage, outflow and downstream water balance; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Flood gauging and river model” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for flow, level, section and calibration records for the same time window, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 只要擋板組裝時間短於洪峰到達時間，就一定來得及安全部署。
可拆擋板在洪水前必須完成整條防線的閉合，預警提前量應以安全施工的最晚時間為終點，而不是只看洪峰到達。
任意增加一倍人力，所有部署流程的總時間就必定減半。
optionsEn: Assembly shorter than time to the flood crest guarantees timely and safe deployment.
A demountable system must close the entire defence before flooding, with lead time ending at the latest safe installation time rather than merely the crest arrival.
Doubling staff anywhere necessarily halves the total duration of every deployment process.
quiz.explanation: 可拆擋板在洪水前必須完成整條防線的閉合，預警提前量應以安全施工的最晚時間為終點，而不是只看洪峰到達。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A demountable system must close the entire defence before flooding, with lead time ending at the latest safe installation time rather than merely the crest arrival. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預警提前量與時間餘裕」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Warning lead time and float” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設可用提前量TL=8 h，通知0.5 h、動員1 h、運輸1.5 h、組裝3 h、查驗0.5 h，所需6.5 h，餘裕1.5 h。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume available lead time 8 h: alert 0.5 h, mobilization 1 h, transport 1.5 h, assembly 3 h and inspection 0.5 h. Required time is 6.5 h; float is 1.5 h. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依真實演練記錄各階段開始與結束，檢查是否有重疊或共享資源，並將路線中斷與較快上升洪水列入情境。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record actual start and finish times during exercises, checking overlap and shared resources.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設可用提前量TL=8 h，通知0.5 h、動員1 h、運輸1.5 h、組裝3 h、查驗0.5 h，所需6.5 h，餘裕1.5 h。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume available lead time 8 h: alert 0.5 h, mobilization 1 h, transport 1.5 h, assembly 3 h and inspection 0.5 h. Required time is 6.5 h; float is 1.5 h.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 板材能承受水壓，就能自動證明立柱底座與地基也完全足夠。
密封條只要算出正的壓縮量，就已證明接觸壓力足夠且完全不漏水。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設可用提前量TL=8 h，通知0.5 h、動員1 h、運輸1.5 h、組裝3 h、查驗0.5 h，所需6.5 h，餘裕1.5 h。
optionsEn: A panel resisting water pressure automatically proves its post base and foundation adequate.
Any positive calculated seal compression proves adequate contact pressure and zero leakage.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume available lead time 8 h: alert 0.5 h, mobilization 1 h, transport 1.5 h, assembly 3 h and inspection 0.5 h.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設可用提前量TL=8 h，通知0.5 h、動員1 h、運輸1.5 h、組裝3 h、查驗0.5 h，所需6.5 h，餘裕1.5 h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume available lead time 8 h: alert 0.5 h, mobilization 1 h, transport 1.5 h, assembly 3 h and inspection 0.5 h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預警提前量與時間餘裕」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Warning lead time and float” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依真實演練記錄各階段開始與結束，檢查是否有重疊或共享資源，並將路線中斷與較快上升洪水列入情境。以安全截止時間而非單一洪峰預報比較所需時間，清楚保留不確定度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record actual start and finish times during exercises, checking overlap and shared resources. Include interrupted routes and faster-rising floods in scenarios, comparing required duration against the safe closure deadline rather than one crest forecast while retaining uncertainty in both quantities. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把一場假設部署畫成時間線，列出安全截止與預報誤差，再加入交通延遲。比較是否仍有完整查驗時間，並說明不能為了表面準時而省略閉合檢查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw a deployment timeline with a safe deadline and forecast uncertainty, then introduce traffic delay. Check whether full inspection time remains and explain why omitting closure verification cannot be used to create apparent on-time completion.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看組裝速度會漏掉通知和運輸，重複加總平行工作又可能高估時間；若以洪峰當截止而場地更早進水，即使名義餘裕為正也無法安全完成閉合。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Considering assembly alone misses alert and transport time, while adding parallel tasks twice can overstate duration. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依真實演練記錄各階段開始與結束，檢查是否有重疊或共享資源，並將路線中斷與較快上升洪水列入情境。以安全截止時間而非單一洪峰預報比較所需時間，清楚保留不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: Record actual start and finish times during exercises, checking overlap and shared resources. Include interrupted routes and faster-rising floods in scenarios, comparing required duration against the safe closure deadline rather than one crest forecast while retaining uncertainty in both quantities.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把一場假設部署畫成時間線，列出安全截止與預報誤差，再加入交通延遲。比較是否仍有完整查驗時間，並說明不能為了表面準時而省略閉合檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Draw a deployment timeline with a safe deadline and forecast uncertainty, then introduce traffic delay. Check whether full inspection time remains and explain why omitting closure verification cannot be used to create apparent on-time completion.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification"?
options: 依真實演練記錄各階段開始與結束，檢查是否有重疊或共享資源，並將路線中斷與較快上升洪水列入情境。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
每塊擋板的額定高度足夠，就不需要檢查兩端與地下開口的連續性。
optionsEn: Record actual start and finish times during exercises, checking overlap and shared resources.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Adequate rated height of every panel removes the need to check ends and buried openings.
quiz.explanation: 依真實演練記錄各階段開始與結束，檢查是否有重疊或共享資源，並將路線中斷與較快上升洪水列入情境。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record actual start and finish times during exercises, checking overlap and shared resources. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預警提前量與時間餘裕」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Warning lead time and float” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看組裝速度會漏掉通知和運輸，重複加總平行工作又可能高估時間；若以洪峰當截止而場地更早進水，即使名義餘裕為正也無法安全完成閉合。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Considering assembly alone misses alert and transport time, while adding parallel tasks twice can overstate duration. Using crest time as the deadline may falsely show positive float even though access or safe working conditions are lost earlier. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例各階段依序不重疊，提前量與工時均是假設值，不是任何城市的動員觸發門檻；未將人員安全截止時間等同於水到板頂。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The safe working deadline is not assumed to occur when water reaches the barrier top.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要擋板組裝時間短於洪峰到達時間，就一定來得及安全部署。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Assembly shorter than time to the flood crest guarantees timely and safe deployment." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只看組裝速度會漏掉通知和運輸，重複加總平行工作又可能高估時間；若以洪峰當截止而場地更早進水，即使名義餘裕為正也無法安全完成閉合。
knowledge.textEn: Considering assembly alone misses alert and transport time, while adding parallel tasks twice can overstate duration. Using crest time as the deadline may falsely show positive float even though access or safe working conditions are lost earlier.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只看組裝速度會漏掉通知和運輸，重複加總平行工作又可能高估時間；若以洪峰當截止而場地更早進水，即使名義餘裕為正也無法安全完成閉合。
任意增加一倍人力，所有部署流程的總時間就必定減半。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Considering assembly alone misses alert and transport time, while adding parallel tasks twice can overstate duration.
Doubling staff anywhere necessarily halves the total duration of every deployment process.
quiz.explanation: 只看組裝速度會漏掉通知和運輸，重複加總平行工作又可能高估時間；若以洪峰當截止而場地更早進水，即使名義餘裕為正也無法安全完成閉合。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Considering assembly alone misses alert and transport time, while adding parallel tasks twice can overstate duration. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 平行班組與資源瓶頸機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Parallel crews and bottlenecks mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「平行班組與資源瓶頸」如何影響移動式防洪擋板部署的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Parallel crews and bottlenecks” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deployable flood-barrier systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 增加班組只會加速可真正平行的工作，卸貨機具、單一道路或依序接續的構件仍可能控制總工期。網路排程需要先列工作相依與共同資源，再找最長路徑；平均每人每小時的產量不能直接乘所有人數，因為相互干擾、交接和查驗會限制現場有效產能。本例兩個區段同時開始且人力完全獨立，完成後才能共同進行最終查驗；不含共用吊具、交通或未列前置作業。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「平行班組與資源瓶頸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: More crews accelerate only work that can genuinely run in parallel; unloading equipment, a single access road or sequentially connected components may still govern duration. Network scheduling first identifies dependencies and shared resources, then the longest path. Individual output cannot simply be multiplied by headcount because interference, handover and inspection constrain effective production. Two sections start together with fully independent crews, followed by one final inspection only after both finish. Shared lifting equipment, traffic and unlisted preliminary work are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Parallel crews and bottlenecks” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設區段A需2.0 h、B需3.5 h且可平行，最後共同查驗0.5 h，總時間T=max(2.0,3.5)+0.5=4.0 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent parallel sections A=2.0 h and B=3.5 h, followed by 0.5 h joint inspection.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任意增加一倍人力，所有部署流程的總時間就必定減半。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Doubling staff anywhere necessarily halves the total duration of every deployment process." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「平行班組與資源瓶頸」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Parallel crews and bottlenecks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 平行班組與資源瓶頸機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Parallel crews and bottlenecks mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 增加班組只會加速可真正平行的工作，卸貨機具、單一道路或依序接續的構件仍可能控制總工期。網路排程需要先列工作相依與共同資源，再找最長路徑；平均每人每小時的產量不能直接乘所有人數，因為相互干擾、交接和查驗會限制現場有效產能。
knowledge.textEn: More crews accelerate only work that can genuinely run in parallel; unloading equipment, a single access road or sequentially connected components may still govern duration. Network scheduling first identifies dependencies and shared resources, then the longest path.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任意增加一倍人力，所有部署流程的總時間就必定減半。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Doubling staff anywhere necessarily halves the total duration of every deployment process. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「平行班組與資源瓶頸機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Parallel crews and bottlenecks mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 任意增加一倍人力，所有部署流程的總時間就必定減半。
只要總件數和總重量足夠，就能保證每個區段的構件都相容。
增加班組只會加速可真正平行的工作，卸貨機具、單一道路或依序接續的構件仍可能控制總工期。
optionsEn: Doubling staff anywhere necessarily halves the total duration of every deployment process.
Sufficient total count and mass guarantee compatible components for every barrier section.
More crews accelerate only work that can genuinely run in parallel.
quiz.explanation: 增加班組只會加速可真正平行的工作，卸貨機具、單一道路或依序接續的構件仍可能控制總工期。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: More crews accelerate only work that can genuinely run in parallel; unloading equipment, a single access road or sequentially connected components may still govern duration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 平行班組與資源瓶頸機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Parallel crews and bottlenecks mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「平行班組與資源瓶頸」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Parallel crews and bottlenecks” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設區段A需2.0 h、B需3.5 h且可平行，最後共同查驗0.5 h，總時間T=max(2.0,3.5)+0.5=4.0 h。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent parallel sections A=2.0 h and B=3.5 h, followed by 0.5 h joint inspection. Total T=max(2.0,3.5)+0.5=4.0 h. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以演練逐項核對可平行的真實條件，追蹤吊具、車輛、鑰匙和檢查人員的共享時段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify actual parallelism in exercises and track shared lifting equipment, vehicles, keys and inspectors over time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設區段A需2.0 h、B需3.5 h且可平行，最後共同查驗0.5 h，總時間T=max(2.0,3.5)+0.5=4.0 h。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent parallel sections A=2.0 h and B=3.5 h, followed by 0.5 h joint inspection. Total T=max(2.0,3.5)+0.5=4.0 h.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「平行班組與資源瓶頸機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Parallel crews and bottlenecks mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設區段A需2.0 h、B需3.5 h且可平行，最後共同查驗0.5 h，總時間T=max(2.0,3.5)+0.5=4.0 h。
增加自重一定能解決所有臨時防洪系統的滑動、滲水與承載問題。
擋板閉合後只要任何一台泵在運轉，內側水位就一定不會上升。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent parallel sections A=2.0 h and B=3.5 h, followed by 0.5 h joint inspection.
Added weight necessarily solves every sliding, seepage and bearing problem of a temporary barrier.
Once barriers close, any running pump guarantees that interior water level cannot rise.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設區段A需2.0 h、B需3.5 h且可平行，最後共同查驗0.5 h，總時間T=max(2.0,3.5)+0.5=4.0 h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent parallel sections A=2.0 h and B=3.5 h, followed by 0.5 h joint inspection. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 平行班組與資源瓶頸機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Parallel crews and bottlenecks mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「平行班組與資源瓶頸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Parallel crews and bottlenecks” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以演練逐項核對可平行的真實條件，追蹤吊具、車輛、鑰匙和檢查人員的共享時段。檢查短路徑加人是否能改變最長路徑，再用不同班表或設備故障情境重算總時程。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify actual parallelism in exercises and track shared lifting equipment, vehicles, keys and inspectors over time. Test whether adding staff to a shorter branch changes the critical path, then recalculate total duration for altered shifts or equipment outages rather than assuming proportional acceleration. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在兩條平行路徑上加入一台共用吊車，重新安排不能重疊的時段。比較增加班組與增加瓶頸設備的效果，說明需要記錄的現場交接資訊。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Introduce one shared crane into two parallel paths and reschedule nonoverlapping tasks. Compare adding crews with adding bottleneck equipment and identify the field handover information needed to validate the resulting schedule.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把兩段都假設獨立但共用唯一吊車會低估工期，將人員加到非關鍵工作也不一定提早閉合；忽略最後整線查驗，可能讓局部完成被誤報為全線可用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assuming independent sections that share one crane understates duration. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以演練逐項核對可平行的真實條件，追蹤吊具、車輛、鑰匙和檢查人員的共享時段。檢查短路徑加人是否能改變最長路徑，再用不同班表或設備故障情境重算總時程。
knowledge.textEn: Verify actual parallelism in exercises and track shared lifting equipment, vehicles, keys and inspectors over time. Test whether adding staff to a shorter branch changes the critical path, then recalculate total duration for altered shifts or equipment outages rather than assuming proportional acceleration.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在兩條平行路徑上加入一台共用吊車，重新安排不能重疊的時段。比較增加班組與增加瓶頸設備的效果，說明需要記錄的現場交接資訊。
knowledge.textEn: Introduce one shared crane into two parallel paths and reschedule nonoverlapping tasks. Compare adding crews with adding bottleneck equipment and identify the field handover information needed to validate the resulting schedule.

quiz.question: 要驗證「平行班組與資源瓶頸機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Parallel crews and bottlenecks mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以演練逐項核對可平行的真實條件，追蹤吊具、車輛、鑰匙和檢查人員的共享時段。
四個必要環節各有百分之九十八成功率，整個流程就必定也是百分之九十八。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Verify actual parallelism in exercises and track shared lifting equipment, vehicles, keys and inspectors over time.
Four necessary stages each succeeding ninety-eight percent make the entire process ninety-eight percent reliable.
quiz.explanation: 以演練逐項核對可平行的真實條件，追蹤吊具、車輛、鑰匙和檢查人員的共享時段。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify actual parallelism in exercises and track shared lifting equipment, vehicles, keys and inspectors over time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 平行班組與資源瓶頸機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Parallel crews and bottlenecks mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「平行班組與資源瓶頸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Parallel crews and bottlenecks” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把兩段都假設獨立但共用唯一吊車會低估工期，將人員加到非關鍵工作也不一定提早閉合；忽略最後整線查驗，可能讓局部完成被誤報為全線可用。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assuming independent sections that share one crane understates duration. Adding people to a noncritical activity may not advance closure, and omitted final inspection lets local completion be incorrectly reported as a fully functioning defence line. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例兩個區段同時開始且人力完全獨立，完成後才能共同進行最終查驗；不含共用吊具、交通或未列前置作業。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Shared lifting equipment, traffic and unlisted preliminary work are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「任意增加一倍人力，所有部署流程的總時間就必定減半。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Doubling staff anywhere necessarily halves the total duration of every deployment process." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把兩段都假設獨立但共用唯一吊車會低估工期，將人員加到非關鍵工作也不一定提早閉合；忽略最後整線查驗，可能讓局部完成被誤報為全線可用。
knowledge.textEn: Assuming independent sections that share one crane understates duration. Adding people to a noncritical activity may not advance closure, and omitted final inspection lets local completion be incorrectly reported as a fully functioning defence line.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「平行班組與資源瓶頸機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Parallel crews and bottlenecks mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要總件數和總重量足夠，就能保證每個區段的構件都相容。
把兩段都假設獨立但共用唯一吊車會低估工期，將人員加到非關鍵工作也不一定提早閉合；忽略最後整線查驗，可能讓局部完成被誤報為全線可用。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Sufficient total count and mass guarantee compatible components for every barrier section.
Assuming independent sections that share one crane understates duration.
quiz.explanation: 把兩段都假設獨立但共用唯一吊車會低估工期，將人員加到非關鍵工作也不一定提早閉合；忽略最後整線查驗，可能讓局部完成被誤報為全線可用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Assuming independent sections that share one crane understates duration. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 構件清點與運輸趟次機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
